# Varme markeder og kunsten at sælge i tide

**Feed**: millionaerklubben  
**Published**: 2026-09-23  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

This episode of the Danish show Millionærklubben is broadly optimistic on equities: strategist Ole Søberg expects MSCI World to return about 20% or more this year, driven by AI-led earnings momentum. The hosts discuss Novo Nordisk's capital markets day, which they see as fairly priced but lacking growth. They also discuss how Meta's new Muse AI agent could hurt subscription and inertia-based businesses. From an investor conference, Ole reports bullishness on offshore oil and gas services, shortlisting Samsung Electronics, Century Aluminum and Odfjell Drilling, and he closes with his checklist for when to sell a stock.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟡 NOVO-B — Novo Nordisk | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Ole (guest) is neutral: fair at P/E 13 but no growth, and he expects no outperformance for 2-3 years. Michael holds 'to the navel' on the upside scenarios.

#### Reasoning

The capital markets day guided about 5% annual growth to 2030. Patent expiries in 2032 must be offset by five new products worth over DKK 150bn. Ole's model gives 10-12% annual return at P/E 16 in 2035, but it depends on the pipeline. Trust in management is low. Michael sees upside from pill capacity for 100M patients and from obesity becoming a consumer 'fitness' market. Neither is adding.

#### Sell Triggers

- if pipeline products fail to deliver the DKK 150bn target
- if the pill launch stalls
- if patent expiries are not offset
- if the 200-day moving average keeps falling

> *"Man skal altså ikke forvente outperformance på Novo-aktien her på de næste to-tre år."*

---

### 🟠 ODL — Odfjell Drilling | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Ole's shortlist from the investor conference because of high growth; he has not bought yet.

#### Reasoning

Offshore drilling has been under-invested for 12 years and no new rigs are being built, which gives existing floaters a moat. Lifting cost is about $20 against oil near $100. Ole researches before buying.

#### Sell Triggers

- if oil demand declines faster than expected
- if due diligence fails Ole's investment principles

> *"og så var det Ottefjeld Drilling. fordi de har meget høj vækst i kommende år"*

---

### 🟠 CENX — Century Aluminum | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

On Ole's post-conference shortlist; not bought yet.

#### Reasoning

Ole ran his conference notes through his investment principles and Century Aluminum came out as one of three names to research further. He says 'invest your time before your money'.

#### Sell Triggers

- if due diligence fails investment criteria

> *"og en, der hedder Century Aluminium"*

---

### 🟡 005930.KS — Samsung Electronics | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Pitched at the conference and on Ole's shortlist; he has owned it for decades.

#### Reasoning

One of the few AI/semiconductor pitches at the conference. It fits Ole's principles and he has held it for many decades.

#### Sell Triggers

- if ROIC falls due to overinvestment
- if valuation becomes excessive

> *"Og det var så Samsung Electronics, som jeg har"*

---

### 🟠 TGS — TGS | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Ole follows it but doesn't own it; up 60% this year, and AI-enhanced seismic data is a tailwind.

#### Reasoning

TGS uses AI to reprocess old seismic data, which benefits from underinvestment in oil exploration. Ole tracks it without a position.

#### Sell Triggers

- if oil exploration spending declines

> *"Jeg følger TGS, men jeg har den ikke lige for øjeblikket."*

---

### 🟠 RIG — Transocean | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Floating-rig owner discussed at the conference; no new rigs are being built, which creates a moat.

#### Reasoning

Rigs last about 40 years and nobody is building new ones. Floaters are replacing jack-ups. Oil demand stays flat or rising until 2035. Michael prefers service companies or the OIH ETF.

#### Sell Triggers

- if oil demand peaks earlier
- if rig supply increases

---

### 🟠 SHOP — Shopify | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Michael sees Shopify's link-up with Meta's Muse as a way to compete better with Amazon.

#### Reasoning

With AI agents making commerce zero-sum, Michael says to pick the winners. Shopify connected to Meta, which may take e-commerce share from Amazon. He admits he hasn't thought the idea all the way through.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Muse adoption fades
- if Amazon launches a competing agent integration

> *"Det var jo Shopify i går, der sagde, at de connectede sig til Meta."*

---

### 🟠 META — Meta | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Muse is the most popular AI app since ChatGPT; Michael thinks the AI-agent theme won't die in three days.

#### Reasoning

Meta has 3bn users to push an AI agent to. The share is rallying. Michael favours the theme but suggests looking at who connects to Meta next rather than Meta itself.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Muse usage does not follow downloads
- if monetization is unclear

> *"Måske ikke Meta, men hvem er den næste?"*

---

### 🟢 NKT — NKT | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Michael wants energy-transition exposure through NKT, Siemens and Schneider.

#### Reasoning

Energy security and the need for European energy independence drive both the transition and fossil services. Michael wants NKT for grid and cable demand.

#### Sell Triggers

- if energy transition investment slows

> *"jeg vil gerne have NKT, jeg vil gerne have Siemens, jeg vil gerne have Schneider Electric"*

---
